title: هجوم — بلاغ UKMTO 214-26 عن إصابة ناقلة بمقذوف على بعد 8 أميال بحرية شمال خصب وحريق على متنها · 20/11/2026
source_excerpt: UKMTO WARNING 214-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 20 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1500UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM north of Khasab, Oman. A Tanker on an outbound transit of the Strait of Hormuz has been struck on the port bow by an unknown projectile. The CSO has reported a fire onboard the vessel. No casualties have been reported at this time. No environmental impact reported.
official_ref_basis: معرّف رسمي من نصّ المصدر: UKMTO-214-26
area_basis: نص البلاغ: 8NM north of Khasab, Oman، في عبور خارج من مضيق هرمز.
outcome: حريق على متن الناقلة؛ لا إصابات ولا أثر بيئي معلن.

title: نشاط مشبوه — بلاغ UKMTO 213-26 عن اقتراب قارب فيه 6 مسلحين من سفينة بضائع على بعد 95 ميلًا بحريًا جنوب غرب المكلا · 20/11/2026
source_excerpt: UKMTO WARNING 213-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 20 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1102UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 95NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen. A Bulk Carrier travelling eastbound in the IRTC was approached on the port side by a dark blue skiff with 6 unidentified, armed persons on board. Four shots were fired in quick succession from the skiff and warning shots were returned by the armed security team onboard the Bulk Carrier.
official_ref_basis: معرّف رسمي من نصّ المصدر: UKMTO-213-26
area_basis: نص البلاغ: 95NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen، في ممر العبور الموصى به.
outcome: تبادل إطلاق نار تحذيري وابتعاد القارب؛ لا ضرر ولا إصابات.
